dropoff.note: Drop off at sales office, PUDO, convenience store, or designated shop. Excludes Nekopos / cone-ko-bin / COD. Source: kuronekoyamato.co.jp/faq id=1782 (verified 2026-04).

member_dropoff.note: Kuroneko Members drop-off at branch with digital label. Replaces standard drop-off (not stackable).

branch_pickup.note: Recipient picks up at sales office.
